manifest.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

rounding.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; both endpoints round to the same binary64 (RNE).
rounding.abi: Every call verifies R4-R11, SP, bounded stack writes.
rounding.semantics: RNE return values; errno and floating exception flags are not implemented.
rounding.nan_result_policy: NaN results must be quiet; payload and sign are unspecified.
known_limitations: An undecided owned 1024-bit pow refinement still traps; all-input totality is unproved.
rounding.scope: Finite corpus, not an exhaustive proof over every binary64 input.

instruction_profile.scope: Executed ARM instructions on the prepared finite corpus, with typed 32-bit return masking. If sides_share_elf is false, owned production symbols and pinned diagnostic Qfplib symbols run on separate instances of the same Cortex-M0 emulator. When actual_bootrom is present, SDK ROM lookup initializers, wrappers and ROM bodies execute without intrinsic models. SIO division remains functionally modeled. These are not hardware cycles, cache comparisons, timings, or proof of speed parity.

intrinsics.scope: Real SDK ROM lookup and bit/memory instructions, pointer alignment, byte canaries, ABI and stack/global write protection. Emulator diagnostics, not hardware cycles.

pow_intervals.scope: Direct calls to both unmodified production interval functions. Real linked memory wrappers and captured ROM execute; saved registers, SP and bounded writes are checked. Caller-owned output is excluded from callee-frame depth. Finite directed-MPFR RNE corpus, not a pow totality proof or a speed comparison.

cache_model.assumptions: Same previously checked 16 KiB / two-way / 8-byte-line cache geometry; LRU/FIFO replacement and whole-line/per-word fills are explicit model assumptions. These are not claims about undocumented prefetch or replacement.
cache_model.scope: Exact ARM instruction/data traces and exact results on nine finite groups per image, with actual ROM and linked memory code. Two warm passes then a measured third pass. Only XIP accesses enter the cache model. Excludes caller prefetch, IRQs, other-core traffic and Qfplib batches. Not measured XIP counters or physical speed evidence.

source_qualification: All five allocated numerical object payloads and 274 linked ordinary text/rodata input addresses are identical to V77. The complete memory candidate source overlay is preserved; source/ELF identities are checked. Math source is unchanged, including the M4 paths previously qualified in V77.
resource_selection: SRAM has 27944 heap bytes and inherits the memory candidate 30000-byte APP failure. Flash has 30520 heap bytes. No memory placement is selected by this offline report; the agreed physical comparison remains required.
remains: Accept the platform, finish the agreed memory-function comparison, and obtain the final immutable source/restore and explicit device release.
Rebase and qualify the stable math arena on that final source, then measure the full 114-group/116-chunk matrix physically.
General binary64 pow totality outside the exact stage 224 exponents remains unproved; its undecided trap is retained.
